sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 12:109

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 12:109:1
items.html: And the deficiency is in the two Eheyehs in the female, for each one has only forty-one letters: This hints that the mother lacks the upper forty-second gate, which is her Keter — this being the secret of “if you call for Bina,” as the ARI writes in Etz Chaim, Gate 13, Chapter 13, at length. Study it there well.
